title: 烏東德水電站
summary: 烏東德拱壩高 270 m 而厚高比僅約 0.19，是世界最薄的 300 m 級拱壩之一；課程定量分析 12 台 850 MW 機組的出力與極數、薄拱壩的應力與低熱水泥溫控、智慧灌漿與數位化施工、以及金沙江下游四座梯級的水頭銜接。
summaryEn: The Wudongde arch dam is 270 m high with a thickness-to-height ratio of only about 0.19, among the thinnest 300 m-class arch dams; the course quantifies output and pole number of its twelve 850 MW units, stress and low-heat-cement temperature control in the thin arch, intelligent grouting and digital construction, and the head linkage of the four lower Jinsha cascade stations.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 薄型特高拱壩、850 MW 機組與岸邊洩洪洞的整體設計
v30FocusEn: Integrated design of a thin ultra-high arch dam, 850 MW units and bank spillway tunnels

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：烏東德水電站
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Wudongde Hydropower Station
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水頭、流量與出力」與「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head, discharge and output" and "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head, discharge and output" is correct?
options: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
梯級電站各自獨立，只要每一座都盡量多發電，整條河的發電量就最大。
optionsEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
Cascade stations are independent; if each generates as much as it can, the river as a whole produces the most.
quiz.explanation: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「水頭、流量與出力」如何決定「烏東德水電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head, discharge and output” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Wudongde Hydropower Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「烏東德水電站」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Wudongde Hydropower Station, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：12 台機組各 850 MW，總裝置容量 10,200 MW
steps.observationEn: Project file: Twelve 850 MW units give 10,200 MW of installed capacity
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「水頭、流量與出力」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Head, discharge and output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「烏東德水電站」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
knowledge.textEn: A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output. Gross head is the level difference between headwater and tailwater; net head also deducts losses at the trash rack, intake, penstock and draft tube, so the same unit has different output and efficiency in wet and dry seasons. For Wudongde Hydropower Station, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 12 台機組各 850 MW，總裝置容量 10,200 MW
knowledge.textEn: Twelve 850 MW units give 10,200 MW of installed capacity

quiz.question: 依「水頭、流量與出力」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，額定工況的單機電氣出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Head, discharge and output", which value is closest to the electrical output of one unit at rated conditions?
options: 431 MW
862 MW
optionsEn: 431 MW
862 MW
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 690 m³/s、H = 137 m、η = 0.93，得 862 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 690 m³/s, H = 137 m, η = 0.93 the result is 862 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭、流量與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head, discharge and output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 690 m³/s、H = 137 m、η = 0.93，得 862 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 690 m³/s, H = 137 m, η = 0.93 the result is 862 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 949 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 949 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 862 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 862 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 690 m³/s、H = 137 m、η = 0.93，得 862 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。
knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 690 m³/s, H = 137 m, η = 0.93 the result is 862 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 949 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 949 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head, discharge and output"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
混凝土強度越高、水泥越多，壩體就越安全。
以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher strength and more cement always make a dam safer.

Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭、流量與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head, discharge and output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「水頭、流量與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head, discharge and output" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
梯級電站各自獨立，只要每一座都盡量多發電，整條河的發電量就最大。
optionsEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
Cascade stations are independent; if each generates as much as it can, the river as a whole produces the most.
quiz.explanation: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭、流量與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Head, discharge and output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「烏東德水電站」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Wudongde Hydropower Station”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「烏東德水電站」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For Wudongde Hydropower Station, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
knowledge.textEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 關於「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations" is correct?
options: 梯級電站各自獨立，只要每一座都盡量多發電，整條河的發電量就最大。
水輪機型式只由水頭決定，與流量和轉速無關。
烏東德、白鶴灘、溪洛渡與向家壩自上而下首尾相接：上一級的尾水位大致就是下一級的水庫回水，四座電站共用同一股水流，合計裝置容量約 4,646 萬瓩。
optionsEn: Cascade stations are independent; if each generates as much as it can, the river as a whole produces the most.
Turbine type is decided by head alone, independent of discharge and speed.

Wudongde, Baihetan, Xiluodu and Xiangjiaba follow one another down the river: the tailwater of each is roughly the backwater of the next reservoir, so the four stations share one flow and total about 46,460 MW.

quiz.explanationEn: Wudongde, Baihetan, Xiluodu and Xiangjiaba follow one another down the river: the tailwater of each is roughly the backwater of the next reservoir, so the four stations share one flow and total about 46,460 MW. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 金沙江下游四級梯級銜接：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」如何決定「烏東德水電站」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Wudongde Hydropower Station”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 烏東德、白鶴灘、溪洛渡與向家壩自上而下首尾相接：上一級的尾水位大致就是下一級的水庫回水，四座電站共用同一股水流，合計裝置容量約 4,646 萬瓩。上游水庫的調節讓下游各級在枯水期多發電，但任何一級的出庫變化都會在數小時後傳到下一級，因此必須由同一個梯級調度中心統一安排。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wudongde, Baihetan, Xiluodu and Xiangjiaba follow one another down the river: the tailwater of each is roughly the backwater of the next reservoir, so the four stations share one flow and total about 46,460 MW. Regulation by upstream reservoirs lets downstream stations generate more in the dry season, but a change in release from any one reaches the next within hours, so one cascade dispatch centre must schedule them together. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：混凝土雙曲拱壩最大壩高 270 m，壩底厚約 51 m，厚高比約 0.19

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「梯級電站各自獨立，只要每一座都盡量多發電，整條河的發電量就最大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Cascade stations are independent; if each generates as much as it can, the river as a whole produces the most." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: Wudongde, Baihetan, Xiluodu and Xiangjiaba follow one another down the river: the tailwater of each is roughly the backwater of the next reservoir, so the four stations share one flow and total about 46,460 MW. Regulation by upstream reservoirs lets downstream stations generate more in the dry season, but a change in release from any one reaches the next within hours, so one cascade dispatch centre must schedule them together.

quiz.question: 依「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」的模型 e = g·ΣH·η / 3600，每 1 m³ 水流經四級電站合計可發的電量（水頭取各站額定值近似）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model e = g·ΣH·η / 3600 for "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations", which value is closest to the energy generated by 1 m³ of water passing all four stations (heads approximated by rated values)?
options: 1.59 kWh/m³
15.9 kWh/m³
0.797 kWh/m³
optionsEn: 1.59 kWh/m³
15.9 kWh/m³
0.797 kWh/m³
quiz.explanation: e = g·ΣH·η / 3600；代入 g = 9.81、H1 = 137 m、H2 = 202 m、H3 = 197 m、H4 = 100 m、η = 0.92，得 1.59 kWh/m³（每 1 m³ 水流經四級電站合計可發的電量（水頭取各站額定值近似））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: e = g·ΣH·η / 3600; with g = 9.81, H1 = 137 m, H2 = 202 m, H3 = 197 m, H4 = 100 m, η = 0.92 the result is 1.59 kWh/m³ (energy generated by 1 m³ of water passing all four stations (heads approximated by rated values)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 金沙江下游四級梯級銜接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：e = g·ΣH·η / 3600；代入 g = 9.81、H1 = 137 m、H2 = 202 m、H3 = 197 m、H4 = 100 m、η = 0.92，得 1.59 kWh/m³（每 1 m³ 水流經四級電站合計可發的電量（水頭取各站額定值近似））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H2 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: e = g·ΣH·η / 3600; with g = 9.81, H1 = 137 m, H2 = 202 m, H3 = 197 m, H4 = 100 m, η = 0.92 the result is 1.59 kWh/m³ (energy generated by 1 m³ of water passing all four stations (heads approximated by rated values)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H2 by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H2 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.65 kWh/m³（+3.2%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H2 by 10% changes the result to 1.65 kWh/m³ (+3.2%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 1.59 kWh/m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H2 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 1.59 kWh/m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H2 with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: e = g·ΣH·η / 3600；代入 g = 9.81、H1 = 137 m、H2 = 202 m、H3 = 197 m、H4 = 100 m、η = 0.92，得 1.59 kWh/m³（每 1 m³ 水流經四級電站合計可發的電量（水頭取各站額定值近似））。
knowledge.textEn: e = g·ΣH·η / 3600; with g = 9.81, H1 = 137 m, H2 = 202 m, H3 = 197 m, H4 = 100 m, η = 0.92 the result is 1.59 kWh/m³ (energy generated by 1 m³ of water passing all four stations (heads approximated by rated values)).

knowledge.text: H2 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1.65 kWh/m³（+3.2%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H2 by 10% changes the result to 1.65 kWh/m³ (+3.2%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比對四座電站同一時段的出庫流量、區間入流與發電量，檢查水量平衡與「度電耗水率」，確認梯級聯合調度的增發效益。
灌漿只要把水泥漿灌得越多，防滲效果就越好。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Compare releases, local inflows and generation of the four stations over the same period, check the water balance and water consumed per kWh, and confirm the extra energy gained by joint cascade operation.
The more grout that is injected, the better the seepage barrier.
quiz.explanation: 比對四座電站同一時段的出庫流量、區間入流與發電量，檢查水量平衡與「度電耗水率」，確認梯級聯合調度的增發效益。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare releases, local inflows and generation of the four stations over the same period, check the water balance and water consumed per kWh, and confirm the extra energy gained by joint cascade operation. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 金沙江下游四級梯級銜接：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「金沙江下游四級梯級銜接」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head linkage of the four lower Jinsha stations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對四座電站同一時段的出庫流量、區間入流與發電量，檢查水量平衡與「度電耗水率」，確認梯級聯合調度的增發效益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare releases, local inflows and generation of the four stations over the same period, check the water balance and water consumed per kWh, and confirm the extra energy gained by joint cascade operation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：梯級調度規程要明定各庫的消落次序與蓄水次序，並以「梯級總蓄能」而非單庫水位作為考核指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Cascade rules should fix the order of draw-down and refilling among reservoirs and assess performance by total stored cascade energy rather than single-reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若各站只追求自身發電量而不協調，上游大量放水時下游因水位過高而棄水，整體能量利用率反而下降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If each station maximises its own generation without coordination, large upstream releases force downstream stations to spill at high level and overall energy use falls. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
